ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: The Kyber Trade
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Ash'karr campaign content: selling kyber (KYBER_TRADE_PLOT_1, design/Jawa/kyber_trade_plot_spec.md, K1/K2 RULED 2026-09-11).
Every kyber crystal (or mindstone) sold in any trade window is a crime the Empire hunts: Imperial attention rises substantially on the Colony Visibility meter (the campaign's one Empire attention meter, which paces the pursuit), Hutt interest rises, and the Hutt Cartel's goodwill rises when they are the buyer. Gifts, crafting and the donation are never sales.
After the second sale, once per campaign, Homestead Defense League moisture farmers walk in to ask how the kyber was obtained. One of them carries no weapon and nothing that confirms anything; nobody says "Jedi". Any answer is forthright (goodwill, a warning, and a door); saying nothing is evasive, with no punishment.
Through that door, or through the Cartel fixer once Hutt interest is high when the visit went nowhere, one ask comes: donate kyber, smuggled offworld from a settlement on the lane, to a cause fighting somewhere else. It pays a letter of thanks and modest Homestead goodwill, moves no Heat, and nothing ever helps the Rebellion here: they lost, that's it. Refused or failed, it never comes again.
Mod Settings: one switch for what a sale moves, one for the plot, and the numbers.
